description: This Java source file defines an immutable implementation of the ResourceKey interface, representing resource identifiers with a type and a path. It provides factory method for instantiation, accessor methods, and overrides for Object methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutableResourceKey
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ResourceKey interface, encapsulating resource type and path, with methods for creation and access.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableResourceKey instance with specified type and path, ensuring inputs are valid.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path as a JsonPointer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation of the resource key.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Provides the character at the specified index in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation between start and end indices.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on resource type and path.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on resource type and path.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string combining resource type and path with a delimiter.
